# mcloud dev

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

Run the app here, all its functions in one process.

Run the app in the current repo on this machine, with what it gets on
maxcloud:

  - every HTTP function at http://&lt;name&gt;.localhost:8080/ (a list at
    http://localhost:8080/), queue workers running, and scheduled
    functions run with POST http://localhost:8080/\_run/&lt;name&gt;;
  - DATABASE\_URL: a local Postgres in Docker (--db local, the default when
    maxcloud.yaml has db:), a branch of the app's database through a
    port-forward (--db branch:NAME, see mcloud db branch), or none; the
    pending migrations in migrations/ are applied to it first (see mcloud
    db migrate);
  - MAXCLOUD\_APP, so bucketName() works;
  - secrets from .env in the repo and in source: (keep them out of git),
    or the app's own from the cluster (--secrets remote);
  - the app's real buckets with --buckets (careful: real data).

It runs in the app's folder: source: in maxcloud.yaml, else the folder
maxcloud.yaml is in. TypeScript runs your source with Node's type
stripping and restarts on changes (node --watch); Go apps run with go run
(restart it yourself). A Nuxt app (a nuxt.config) runs nuxt dev on the
port instead, at http://localhost:8080/; @max-cloud/nuxt fills its
runtimeConfig from the same environment.

```
mcloud dev [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud dev
mcloud dev --db branch:try-migration
mcloud dev --secrets remote --buckets
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--buckets` |  | use the app's real buckets (its S3 credentials from the cluster) |
| `--db` string |  | local, branch:NAME or none (default: local if maxcloud.yaml has db:, else none) |
| `--entry` string |  | TypeScript: the module exporting the functions (default src/index.ts, else package.json main) |
| `--migrate` | `true` | apply the pending migrations in migrations/ to the database first |
| `--port` int | `8080` | port to serve the HTTP functions on |
| `--secrets` string | `local` | local (.env) or remote (the app's secrets on the cluster, and .env) |
